messages.raw:
From: City Council <registrations@citycouncil.example>
To: demo@local.test
Subject: Reminder: parking permit renewal closes {{+9d}}
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:00:00 +0000
Message-ID: <council-2201@citycouncil.example>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset="UTF-8"

Dear resident,

This is a reminder that your residential parking permit must be renewed. The
renewal window closes on {{+9d}} and permits are not renewed after that
date.

Please submit your renewal application before {{+9d}}. Applications received
after the closing date cannot be processed for the current year, and a new permit
cannot be issued until the following cycle opens.

Renewal applications can be submitted at the office or through the online portal.

City Council Registrations
